templates.title: Bold sale announcement
templates.description: A bold sale post: a shopper in an orange shape, a script "Super offer" over a heavy headline, a discount badge and a dark band with your contact line and a Shop now button.

templates.title: Serif quote card
templates.description: A minimalist quote post: black, a centred serif quote with one word in capitals and one in italics, and a small handle at the foot.

templates.title: Rooftop event story
templates.description: A full-bleed photo story: tiny labels at the top, a big lowercase title with the time and a line of text, a strip of dates with the day picked out.

templates.title: Modern pitch deck
templates.description: A clean investor deck in white, ink and one blue: a cover with a photo panel, the problem as three cards and the market as nested circles.

templates.title: Night Bloom concert poster
templates.description: A tour poster for 18 x 24 in print: the act in huge gradient type between two outlined words, the city, venue and date on a warm band, and the special guest below.

templates.title: Grand opening flyer
templates.description: An elegant grand opening flyer for US Letter: a sweeping script "Grand" over a spaced serif "Opening", and the time, day and place in three columns.

templates.title: Botanical celebration invitation
templates.description: A minimalist 5 x 7 in wedding invitation: a fine line-drawn sprig, the names in spaced serif capitals with a script "and", and the date in a row split by hairlines.

templates.title: Modern resume
templates.description: An elegant two-column A4 resume with a round photo: the name in spaced capitals, contacts with icons, and experience along a fine timeline.

templates.title: Bold YouTube thumbnail
templates.description: A bold challenge thumbnail: deep blue to violet with streaks of light, a face on the right, a huge yellow "30 days" and a red pill.

templates.title: Clean business card
templates.description: An elegant two-sided business card: a charcoal front with a faint script name behind your name in spaced capitals, and a back with your contacts and a QR code.
